analysis: Current on-chain data points to an accumulation zone for Bitcoin. Long-term holders are adding to positions (+260k BTC in 30 days) while cold storage supply grows at +1.28% — two signals that patient capital is absorbing available supply. The Puell Multiple at 0.72 indicates miners are earning below their annual average, historically a condition that reduces natural sell pressure. With the MVRV Z-Score at 0.67 (below its long-term mean) and no metric in distribution territory, the current configuration has historically represented a favorable window for long-term investors willing to hold through cycle volatility.
